**Status: DONE.** Old per-entry cache directory deleted, `.gitignore` re-pointed to the single file, and `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json` regenerated by a real `pnpm db:seed` under the current fingerprint. All validation, no-rewrite, and git assertions pass.

(An earlier attempt hit a transient stack-down window and was reported BLOCKED; the orchestrator brought the local Docker stack up and I retried per the corrected sequence below.)

## Objective

Old `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/` directory gone, `.gitignore` re-pointed to the single committed file, and `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json` regenerated by a real `pnpm db:seed` under the current crypto fingerprint.

## Files changed

- `.gitignore` — swapped the `!scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/` re-include for `!scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json`; kept `!scripts/.cache/`, `scripts/.cache/*`, and `scripts/.cache/local/` exactly; rewrote the explanatory comment block to describe the new single committed file.
- `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/` — deleted (working-tree `rm -rf`, not a git command).
- `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json` — **created** as a byproduct of `pnpm db:seed` only; never hand-authored. 244 KB single file (was 2.2 MB across 558 files).

### .gitignore diff (semantic)

```
-# Seed-crypto cache is committed: a fingerprint-keyed performance cache of OPAQUE
-# crypto fixtures. The live seed writes a new file here on every cache miss and
-# reuses committed files on a hit; it is committed so CI and matching-secret devs
-# get clean hits, and it self-invalidates when packages/crypto changes the crypto
-# fingerprint. Only this cache is re-included — everything else under
-# scripts/.cache/ (per-slot deps.hash/heartbeat) is runtime churn and stays ignored.
 !scripts/.cache/
 scripts/.cache/*
-!scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/
+# scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json is committed: a single fingerprint-keyed map of
+# OPAQUE seed fixtures. The live seed reuses it on a hit and rewrites it wholesale
+# on a miss; it is committed so CI and matching-secret devs get clean hits, and it
+# self-invalidates (the whole file is rewritten) when packages/crypto changes the
+# crypto fingerprint or CACHE_VERSION bumps. Only this file is re-included —
+# everything else under scripts/.cache/ (per-slot deps.hash/heartbeat) is runtime
+# churn and stays ignored.
 !scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json
 # Local dev-stack runtime state (heartbeats, deps hashes); per-machine, never committed.
 scripts/.cache/local/
```

- Before: `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/` contained **558** files on disk (408 tracked).
- `rm -rf scripts/.cache/seed-crypto/` — directory confirmed gone.
- `scripts/.cache/` now holds only `local/` and the new `seed-crypto.json`; no `.tmp` residue.

## Regeneration sequence (stack was up)

Ran from repo root, per orchestrator correction (`db:seed` has no ensure-stack prefix and does not refresh the catalog):

1. `pnpm db:migrate` — `migrations applied successfully!` (exit 0). Fresh containers had an empty schema.
2. `pnpm catalog:refresh` — `391 discovered, 204 written, 0 unchanged, 187 excluded` (exit 0). Populated `model_catalog` for the seed's dev conversations.
3. `pnpm db:seed` (first run) — exit 0:
   ```
   seed[catalog]: synthetic strict-image model upserted.
   seed[test personas]: 309 personas processed, 309 newly created; 309 wallet balances set.
   seed[dev]: 4 personas processed, 4 newly created; 5 screenshot + 1 charlie conversation; alice billing history; admin op-target states.
   seed[public stats]: 252 usage records created; snapshot written via the public-stats-snapshot cron entry.
   ```
   With the old dir gone and the new file absent, every persona missed → seed generated real OPAQUE + wrote `scripts/.cache/seed-crypto.json`.

- top-level `schemaVersion` = **1** (=== `SCHEMA_VERSION`).

- Formatting (written by `writeCache`, confirmed): keys sorted ascending (313), 2-space indent (`JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) + "\n" === raw` → true), trailing newline present, valid JSON.
